t: What he opened the night prayer with
a: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَئِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
p: Allāhumma rabba Jibrīla wa Mīkāʾīla wa Isrāfīl, fāṭira-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ, ʿālima-l-ghaybi wa-sh-shahādah, anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
m: O Allah, Lord of Jibril and Mika'il and Israfil, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants in what they used to differ about.
